videos.title: Mamba part 2 - Can it replace Transformers?
videos.description: This session is the second in a series that discusses Mamba, a new sequence model backbone based on the Selective State Space model (SSM).  The Selective State Space model allows Mamba to address performance issues often found in the Transformer model which currently powers most of the best-known Foundation models.   In the session we dive deeper into how Mamba is able to have 5 times higher throughput than the Transformer and scale linearly versus quadratic with data sequence length.  This lets it handle long sequences and make accurate predictions of the next value in a sequence and train much faster.  And allows it to achieve state of the art performance in tasks such as next word prediction, DNA sequences prediction, generating images, and much more.    Mamba also takes advantage of the implementation of hardware accelerators to execute operations in the most efficient manner on these hardware accelerators.  Such as re-executing computations rather than storing and retrieving intermediate values from slow memory. The resulting combination of efficient implementation and long sequence capability makes Mamba a model we all need to understand and utilize, and perhaps use in place of Transformers.  *Links* Our Meetup: https://www.meetup.com/East-Bay-Tri-Valley-Machine-Learning-Meetup/ Mamba:Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces - https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.00752 Samuel Albanie's video - a replacement for Transformers?: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ouF-H35atOY Yannic Kilcher's video - Mamba- Linear-Time Sequence With SSS (Paper Explained) : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9dSkvxS2EB0  *Content* 00:00 Introduction 00:49 Mamba review 10:14 Mamba vs S4 14:59 Video Mamba replacement for Transformers 31:03 Video 1 Q & A 42:54 Video Mamba paper explained 01:08:02 Video 2 Q & A  ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ 😊About Us  West Coast Machine Learning is a channel dedicated to exploring the exciting world of machine learning!
